description: TEE-V2 prometheus-multi-tenant-proxy (ETHOS-115242): stop silent per-tenant collection stalls. Verify the HEAD reconcile fix under repro, harden runtime reconcile-on-add, add a self-heal watchdog (recreate in-process job, then restart pod as last resort), expose per-tenant collection-health metrics, and ship a fleet-wide silent-stall alert.

userStories.title: Reproduce and characterize the wedge against the HEAD image
userStories.description: As an engineer, I want a repeatable test-harness reproduction of the silent per-tenant collection stall so I can confirm which failure modes HEAD already fixes and scope the remaining hardening.
acceptanceCriteria: A test (envtest / fake controller-runtime client.Client) starts the remote-write Controller, then creates a MetricAccess CR with spec.remoteWrite.enabled=true AFTER Start() has run
Test asserts whether the HEAD reconcileLoop creates a collection job for the runtime-added CR within one reconcile interval (documents actual behavior as a passing/failing assertion)
A second scenario mutates the discovered target set (backend pod-IP churn) after job creation and asserts whether collectMetrics recovers via dynamic target resolution
Findings recorded in a short note (residual gaps where a job is running but collects zero series with no error, e.g. the healthyTargets==0 empty-success branch)
Tests pass (go test ./...)
Typecheck passes (go build ./... and go vet ./... succeed)
userStories.notes: HEAD fixes runtime-add (reconcile poll, ~<=30s) and churn (dynamic GetTargets). Residual wedge confirmed: healthyTargets==0 branch stores 0 series, sets no error, job stays Active -> drives US-003/004/005. Harness: internal/remote_write/controller_selfheal_test.go; findings: tasks/us-001-findings.md.

userStories.title: Guarantee runtime reconcile-on-add of remote-write collection jobs
userStories.description: As a tenant, I want my metrics collected within one reconcile interval of my MetricAccess CR being created, even though the proxy was already running.
acceptanceCriteria: With the Controller already started, creating a MetricAccess (remoteWrite.enabled=true) results in a collection job within <= one reconcile interval (<=30s)
Enabling remoteWrite on an existing CR, or changing its metric set, is reconciled (job created or restarted via hasConfigurationChanged)
Deleting or disabling the CR stops and removes the job with no goroutine leak (StopCh closed, job removed from map)
Regression test covers create-after-start, enable-after-start, and delete/disable
Tests pass (go test ./...)
Typecheck passes (go build ./... and go vet ./... succeed)
userStories.notes: HEAD reconcile logic already correct (no prod change). Added 5 regression tests in controller_reconcile_test.go covering create/enable-after-start, metric-set-change restart, delete, disable; RED-proof mutation confirmed they catch the shipped-image bug class. -race clean.

userStories.title: Detect a silent per-tenant collection stall
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the proxy to track per-job collection health so a tenant with an enabled CR producing zero collected series is classified as stalled.
acceptanceCriteria: RemoteWriteJob tracks lastSuccessfulCollectionTime and lastCollectedSeriesCount, where success = >=1 series stored AND remote-write send returned no error
collectMetrics no longer treats an empty result (healthyTargets==0 or zero series) as success; it records a failed/empty cycle and increments a stall counter
A job is classified stalled when: CR enabled AND no successful collection for > stallGracePeriod (default 15m, configurable)
Unit test drives a job to the stalled state and asserts detection
Tests pass (go test ./...)
Typecheck passes (go build ./... and go vet ./... succeed)
userStories.notes: Added RemoteWriteJob health fields (lastSuccessfulCollectionTime, lastCollectedSeriesCount, consecutiveEmptyCollections, createdAt), clock seam Controller.now, config.StallGracePeriod (default 15m), and isJobStalled(). collectMetrics now only counts >=1 series + send-ok as success; empty/zero/send-error advance empty-cycle counter without faking success. US-001/002 tests still green; -race clean.

userStories.title: Self-heal step 1 - auto-recreate the in-process collection job
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a stalled collection job rebuilt in-process automatically before any pod restart.
acceptanceCriteria: When a job is stalled for > stallGracePeriod, the watchdog stops it (stopRemoteWriteJobLocked) and recreates it (createRemoteWriteJobLocked) with fresh target resolution
Recreation is rate-limited by recreateBackoff (default 5m) to avoid thrash
A subsequent successful collection resets stall state and counters
Each recreate is logged with tenant key, stall duration, and attempt count
Test: a job stuck at zero series is auto-recreated and recovers once targets return data, with no manual action
Tests pass (go test ./...)
Typecheck passes (go build ./... and go vet ./... succeed)

userStories.title: Self-heal step 2 - pod restart as last resort
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the pod to restart itself only if in-process recovery fails, so a truly wedged process still recovers unattended.
acceptanceCriteria: If a job stays stalled for > podRestartGracePeriod (default 45m) despite >=1 recreate attempt and self-restart is enabled, the proxy triggers its own restart (non-zero process exit)
Restart is leader-only (only the remote-write leader may self-restart) and is disabled when --self-heal-pod-restart=false; escalation ships enabled by default
Escalation is throttled by podRestartCooldown (default 30m) and emits a WARN log plus increments a restart counter before exiting
Test covers: escalate-only-after-recreate-failed, leader-only, and throttle
Tests pass (go test ./...)
Typecheck passes (go build ./... and go vet ./... succeed)

userStories.title: Expose per-tenant collection-health metrics
userStories.description: As an operator, I want first-class proxy metrics for collection health so alerting does not depend on interpreting the ambiguous up skeleton series.
acceptanceCriteria: Proxy exposes on its metrics endpoint, labeled by tenant namespace and name: proxy_tenant_collection_up, proxy_tenant_last_successful_collection_timestamp_seconds, proxy_tenant_collected_series, proxy_tenant_stall_recreations_total, proxy_tenant_self_restart_total
Metrics are emitted only for tenants with an enabled MetricAccess (no cardinality for absent tenants)
Test asserts proxy_tenant_collection_up flips correctly across stall then recover
Tests pass (go test ./...)
Typecheck passes (go build ./... and go vet ./... succeed)

userStories.title: Ship a fleet-wide PrometheusRule for persistent silent stall
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a PrometheusRule shipped with the proxy that alerts when an onboarded tenant is silently stalled, so a stall is caught within minutes.
acceptanceCriteria: A PrometheusRule manifest is authored for the ethos-core-prometheus-multi-tenant-proxy Helm chart
Primary alert expression uses the health metric: max by (namespace,name) (proxy_tenant_collection_up) == 0 for > 15m at severity warning/major
Corroborating fallback expression documented: up{metrics_path!=""} == 0 persisting per tenant for > 15m (covers old images mid-rollout)
Alert has a runbook annotation referencing the rollout-restart workaround and ETHOS-115242
promtool test rules (or chart lint / helm template) passes for the new rule
Typecheck passes (go build ./... and go vet ./... succeed)
userStories.notes: Alert artifact authored here; the chart change itself lands in the ethos-core-prometheus-multi-tenant-proxy repo (out of scope for this repo's code).

No goroutine leaks across job create/stop (leak check or explicit StopCh assertions)
